label: Huawei OptiXaccess EA5801E-GP04-H2 box OLT
description: Huawei OptiXaccess EA5801E (GP04-H2) - 1U box-shaped GPON OLT with 4 GPON service ports, 4x 10GE/GE SFP+ upstream ports, 95 Gbit/s switching capacity, up to 256 ONTs and dual AC power supplies, for POL and FTTH. -40 to +65 C, under 5 kg.
notes: From the model table: **4 GPON service ports** and **4x 10GE/GE upstream ports**, 95 Gbit/s switching capacity, 256 ONTs. The upstream ports are 10GE/GE cages, so `speedCaps` carries both 1000 and 10000 rather than a bare 10G - a GE optic in the cage must run at 1G. The GPON service ports are 2.5G downstream / 1.25G upstream, which is what `speedCaps: [1244, 2488]` records on every OLT in this catalogue. The datasheet publishes **no ferrule polish** for the PON connectors; `sc-apc` is this catalogue's PON default and matches every other OLT here, so it is an inherited convention rather than a quoted fact - recorded because a UPC/APC mismatch is a real, invisible loss. This is the four-PON member of the family; the GP08-H3 and GP16-H2 differ only in service-port count, switching capacity and ONT scale, so all three are carried rather than guessing which member a request means.
